research_conducted: Prisma Decimal type for financial data
Database schema patterns for money storage

human_feedback.change_requested: Dashboard should show breakdown column with logical grouping, not just total on cards
human_feedback.reasoning: Enable easy cost comparison across colleges, save space with grouped categories
human_feedback.impact: Increased complexity for dashboard layout (+4K tokens), improved UX for cost comparison

memory_learnings: Use Decimal type (@db.Decimal(10, 2)) for financial data in Prisma/PostgreSQL
Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {style: 'currency', currency: 'USD'}) is standard for currency display
Avoid Float for money - precision issues
Calculate totals dynamically to avoid data inconsistency
IMPORTANT: User prefers detailed breakdowns visible in dashboard columns for comparison, not just summary on cards
Logical grouping pattern: Tuition+Fees, Room&Board, Other (books+personal+misc) saves space while showing detail
lessons_for_future_grooming: When cost/pricing features requested, always consider dashboard visibility and comparison needs
Ask about breakdown vs summary display early in grooming
Space-efficient multi-line column layouts are preferred over wide single-line displays
Financial data should enable easy comparison across items (colleges, products, etc.)
